name: Provisional Government of the Republic of China
native: 中華民國臨時政府 (Zhōnghuá Mínguó Línshí Zhèngfǔ)
wikipedia: Provisional Government of the Republic of China (1937–1940)

predecessors.name: Republic of China
predecessors.text: 'nominally controlled the provinces of Hebei, Shandong, Shanxi, Henan and Jiangsu' (the page lists Jiangsu; not drawn)

successors.name: Reorganized National Government of China
successors.text: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based reorganized national government on 30 March 1940'; in practice 'virtually independent' as the North China Political Council

ledger.x: 14 December 1937: the government is inaugurated by Wang Kemin 'on 14 December 1937, with its capital at Beijing', 'formed largely on the initiative of Imperial Japanese Army commanders in north China'.
February 1938: 'absorbed into the collaborationist Provisional Government of China in February 1938'.

30 March 1940: 'merged into Wang Jingwei's Nanjing-based reorganized national government on 30 March 1940'; it 'stayed virtually independent' as the North China Political Council 'until the end of the war'.

wars.name: Second Sino-Japanese War
wars.outcome: The regime was a Japanese creation ('formed largely on the initiative of Imperial Japanese Army commanders') and lasted to the merger of 30 March 1940.

certainty.note: A nominal claim on four provinces: the Japanese army held the towns and lines, the page gives no counties, and the Mengjiang, South Chahar and North Shanxi zones overlap.
